items: 【Small Folding Desk for Small Spaces】Product dimensions is 15.75"D x 31.5"W x 29.52"H when it is unfold, which is so perfect for some small spaces, such as small home office, bed besides, room corner or caravans.
【Folding Desk】Due to the Nylon buckle which is under the desk surface is accurated design to make the folding desk so easy to fold or unfold, but also ensures the table legs stably without shaking.

【Hided Small Desk】Product dimensions is 2.76"D x 31.5"W x 29.52"H when it is folded up, only 2.76" width, very slim to store easily behind a door, under the bed or couch, side of refrigerator, small coner space, or RV etc. when not in use, keeping the tidy of the room.

【Portable Desk】The small folding desk is light and sturdy with only 14.96 pounds, even your 12-Y child could easily move it from bedroom to living room or anywhere; Also can take it away for a travel with your family(easy to disassemble so can adapt more types of car space).

【Easy to Assemble Small Desk】A detailed instruction manual and all tools required for assembling are included. Hassle free & time saving to put the small folding desk together in 3 songs; The Two triangular supporting plates make the table more stable.
